records.research_gloss_separate_from_original_qu: Tenth-house distinct heading below Travels divider, original CLXXXIIII.

Planet strongly placed or lord of tenth can indicate vocation.

Near-exact aspect to Moon also counts as occupation significator.

records.source_short_original_1647_verbatim_frag: Kings and Nobility have no professions
records.research_gloss_separate_from_original_qu: Lilly applies stratified seventeenth-century class assumptions, not empirically universal.

records.source_short_original_1647_verbatim_frag: Mars is designed for the Native
records.research_gloss_separate_from_original_qu: Mars taken as merchant's occupation significator.

records.source_short_original_1647_verbatim_frag: Mars being Lord of the tenth
records.research_gloss_separate_from_original_qu: Source says Mars rules tenth house.

records.source_short_original_1647_verbatim_frag: pronounce to the Native a Profession
records.research_gloss_separate_from_original_qu: Mars aspects several planets and supports existence of profession.
Forecast merchant's profession might change, not fixed for whole life.

records.source_short_original_1647_verbatim_frag: according to the times and directions
records.research_gloss_separate_from_original_qu: Career types said to change with astrological directions; no specific date.
Venus and Sun partnership geometry invoked to support trade.

records.source_short_original_1647_verbatim_frag: things as are usefull for man
records.research_gloss_separate_from_original_qu: Source suggests occupation with useful commercial goods.
Planet placements in 'humane signs' contribute to trade argument.
Mars in Leo linked to metals, minerals, martial/solar commodities.
Venus said to indicate jewellery and women's ornaments as commercial goods.
Mercury said to signify accounting and trade.
Mercury-Sun conjunction used to suggest solar goods/business.
Reader directed to choose among many possible merchandise-significator associations.
Forecast professional advancement, honour and social esteem.
Bright star Lucida Lancis near degree culminating invoked for honour.
Bright star Lucida Lyra near rising invoked for honour.
Jupiter is called strong and lord of the eleventh.
This same natal Cazimi premise appeared earlier in Marriage; not independent evidence.
Lilly predicts wealth and fame from purported Cazimi and other placements.

records.source_short_original_1647_verbatim_frag: according to the quality of his birth
records.research_gloss_separate_from_original_qu: Predicted honour qualified by native's social origin or profession.
Predicts this merchant will have a vocation; already-known occupational context.
Predicts sufficient income from profession.

records.source_short_original_1647_verbatim_frag: much estimation in all those places
records.research_gloss_separate_from_original_qu: Expects recognition in places where he resides.

records.source_short_original_1647_verbatim_frag: The Trine which the Luminaries have
records.research_gloss_separate_from_original_qu: Moon-Sun trine is invoked as an additional positive signal.
Moon near Oculus Taurus used as star evidence.
Predicts sudden unanticipated patronage or advancement.

records.source_short_original_1647_verbatim_frag: preferment from some State, King or Prince
records.research_gloss_separate_from_original_qu: Forecast patronage or position from a ruler; not verified.

Venus with Sun and Moon by ocular Taurus condition are cited for patronage.
Source predicts possible public office or trust.
Jupiter Sagittarius placement and eleventh lord underpins office possibility.

records.source_short_original_1647_verbatim_frag: Profession or quality of the Materials
records.research_gloss_separate_from_original_qu: Lilly advises consideration of actual trade goods before predicting advancement.
Good directed MC/Sun to benevolent promittors considered auspicious.
Forecast native may act more boldly in favourable years.
Opposite unfavourable directions potentially counter supposed success.
Merchant urged to use effort and financial resources, a nonastrological determinant.

records.source_short_original_1647_verbatim_frag: esteem and Credit in the World
records.research_gloss_separate_from_original_qu: Favourable timing and personal effort linked to higher esteem and fortune.
